notes: The Gym Wall (NP_08 s7), the bond board as the sim keeps it. A grid of card cells on the Old Gym's wall; every stablemate's card is pinned to a cell - the club's cards in the stable's order from the cell beside the letter (NP_12A scene 1: 'the first object on the board that becomes the Gym Wall'; scene 3: 'the stable's first card hits the Gym Wall next to the letter'), a recruit beside the stablemate whose string brought him or in the next free cell - and the player may pin any card to any free cell. Proximity is the formation screen's suggestion (NP_10 s2: 'the Gym Wall's card proximities pre-suggest bonded adjacencies'): the starters in the order that walks the wall the shortest way, offered as an order the board may seal, never overriding one sealed. Kizuna lines run between pinned cards whose pair has any Kizuna, filling toward the next level, gilded at Sworn. Decorations unlock from play - a fight poster for a dual won, a ticket stub for the first dual against a club, a polaroid when a bond crosses a level (the bond scene's photograph), hand-wrap graffiti when a recruit joins - and are placed freely: pure expression, zero stats (NP_08 s7: 'kept sacred from optimization'). Nothing on the wall enters the fight's state hash; only a board the player seals from its suggestion changes a fight. The grid's size is the base wall (The Wall facility's tiers, NP_10 s7, are not built); every value here is a first draft.
